rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something before the expected or usual time.

example.english: We left early to avoid traffic.
example.traditional: 我哋早啲出門口，避開塞車。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 bei6 hoi1 sak1 ce1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken adjective for being ahead of schedule, before the usual time, or early in the day; use 早期 instead for an early period or stage.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou2 dou3 zo2 sap6 ng5 fan1 zung1

rows.meaning: at the start of a period
rows.note: Use this before a noun when “early” means belonging to the beginning of a period or stage, such as early works or early cancer.

example.english: This is one of his early works.
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hai6 keoi5 zou2 kei4 ge3 zok3 ban2
